justification: Assessment reported INVALID and targeted exactly the ground-truth defect: the implicit lemma that 3-colourability of the interior part G-bar plus 3-colourability of the boundary dG yields 3-colourability of G. Its witness (5-wheel W5: boundary C5 with chi=3, interior single hub with chi=1, chi(W5)=4 since the hub is adjacent to all five vertices of an odd cycle that forces 3 colours) is a valid, independently correct instance of the same false lemma under the vertex-split reading A of the ground truth (whose witness was K4 with boundary triangle). Different-but-valid witness for the same claim, so matching.
